items.statement: The submitted candidate is explicitly tested as a stationary minimum and the report identifies the imaginary-mode outcome.
items.expected: A converged geometry is accompanied by a frequency or equivalent minimum validation record; no imaginary mode is the source-supported successful outcome.

items.statement: The mean is traceable to five individually identified inner-rim torsions in the fixed atom ordering.
items.expected: Five per-torsion records include four atom indices, convention and values, followed by an arithmetic mean.

items.statement: The calculated mean inner-rim torsion for compound 5 is approximately 27.1 degrees.
items.expected: A reported mean near 27.1 degrees, with method/uncertainty disclosed.

items.statement: The structural calculation is interpreted as agreement with the experimental compound-5 value, within the stated scope.
items.expected: The report compares to the experimental 27.0-degree boundary and frames this as method calibration, not universal validation.
